name: @sos-2/causal
description: SOS 2.0 Causal Knowledge: intervention hypotheses with mechanisms, predicted outcomes, retained assumptions, alternative explanations and refutation conditions; strict OBSERVATIONAL vs INTERVENTIONAL evidence-class separation (a strong causal claim requires intervention evidence — observational-only causal upgrades are rejected at construction); correlation records typed distinctly from causal claims and promoted only explicitly and evidence-gated; the minimal causal graph of factors plus contributes-to/confounds edges; every hypothesis carrying exact evidence provenance and calibrated-or-qualitative uncertainty (Work Order W5; requirements R10, R21, R22, R30).
